notes.title: Engine update, misc changes and a lot of experimental changes
notes.content:
Built on Unreal Engine 5

Enviromental vehicles added, New character models, More streamlining on the building system.
Many small changes to ui to increase ease of use.

Multiplayer has been removed due to issues with voxel system.
Some animations may seem strange or broken Please bear in mind that this is a solo developer project, Many thanks to all those who have helped me with training.

notes.title: small misc update
notes.content: Currently adding sound effects they may be a little off but most are placeholders

notes.title: Small Menu Patch
notes.content:
This patch has been focused on the menu.
button highlight and pointing animation should now work consistently.
All guns now have basic functionality (Still debating line trace or physical projectiles).

notes.title: Misc Patch
notes.content:
Fix Zombies not playing attack animation after last update.
Added a few more useable vehicles to test map.
Updated some icons to show the correct item.

notes.title: Misc Update
notes.content:
There are a few new items that are slowly being introduced.
Alterd Zombies AI to track noises more accurately.
Adressed clipping issues that have been affecting some items.

notes.title: Misc Patch
notes.content:
There are a few items that have been added or enabled.
Offroad vehicle is now active but may be resource heavy for some users, to find it go to the Test map that is found in the exsperimental tab.
Key bindings can be found in the options menu.
Also other small changes to the base mechanics.

notes.title: Small Misc Patch
notes.content:
Some contents are intended for the vehicles (Still disabled due to issues)
Tweaks to menu and ui to improve useability.

notes.title: Small Misc Patch
notes.content:
Enabled hunger and thirst.
Hotbar fixed and enabled with slots 1 2 and 3 being excusive to the primary, left and right weapon slots.
Small changes to the loot system to enable loot types.

Planned changes include being able to build in and change the default buildings as well as introducing more items.
Creating the Voxel Tools to dig and change the landscape.
Animations are being made but making slow progress.

notes.title: Small Misc Patch
notes.content:
Fixed a issue with containers not being able to get contents.
Fixed a issue with the loot box contents not being valid items.
Added icons that match the items they belong to.

notes.title: Reupload of last patch
notes.content: enabled a feature that was disconnected for testing

notes.title: Small Misc Update
notes.content:
Small change to zombie logic they should now attack from a short distance.
Removed build material requirements untill a tutorial is introduced.

notes.title: Small Misc Patch
notes.content:
Change to the menu to stop the players animation moving the cursor.
Fall damage is now active.
a few small tweeks to the building system.

notes.title: small Misc Patch
notes.content:
There are a few small aesthetic changes.
menu fades in the correct order when quitting to menu.
blocked attack when placing building parts.

notes.title: Small Misc Patch
notes.content:
Removed the random spawn at start of the game as it can place the character to close to walls ect blocking the menu.
Currently planning to fix the spawn issue and reuse.

notes.title: Small Misc Patch
notes.content:
Fixed a issue with menu not interacting properly.
Hotkey bar is hidden for the time being.

notes.title: Small Misc Patch 02/08/21
notes.content:
Current update only includes small changes ie the axe is useable on trees, zombies ect.
the following updates will be small changes and bug fixes i am currently working on animations
